input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law (with CISG expressly disapplied) and Section 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County, New York exclusive jurisdiction with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and venue waiver — exactly our preferred position. A document-wide search for "arbitration" returned no results, and no competing governing-law language appears elsewhere. The Section 28.3 executive escalation step is mutual and expressly does not delay urgent relief or a filing needed to preserve a limitations period, and Section 28.2 preserves the right to seek temporary injunctive relief in another court to protect confidential information or IP, so the pre-filing step does not bar court access. No redline required.
